journal-layout-12col.description: 12-column editorial grid with generous 28px gutters for botanical/journal layouts

journal-feature.description: Centered editorial feature occupying 8 columns with 2-column offset on each side

journal-split.description: Asymmetric botanical split: 5-unit narrow column paired with 7-unit wide column

journal-split-reversed.description: Asymmetric botanical split reversed: 7-unit wide column paired with 5-unit narrow column

journal-narrow.description: Narrow centered text column for body copy and editorial prose, spanning 6 columns

journal-aside.description: Narrow column for botanical illustrations, pull quotes, or margin notes

journal-wide.description: Wide centered layout spanning 10 columns with 1-column breathing room on each side

_twist.description: 12-column editorial grid with generous 28px gutters creates breathing room for asymmetric botanical-inspired layouts. Journal utility classes enable editorial composition patterns: full-bleed features, centered editorial blocks with offset, asymmetric 5/7 splits with decorative rules, and narrow text columns. Max width 1520px. Thin 1px botanical dividers use CSS variables.
